0.original: Yubli would have you assist with some alpaca husbandry.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

24.original: Sprinkle insect repellent on the backs of the waiting alpacas.

48.original: Would you be willing to spend some time with the alpacas? The fuzzy creatures need extra-special care in the heat and humidity, and I was hoping you'd oblige.

49.original: To maintain the herd in peak condition, the peddlers periodically treat them with insect repellent. The recipe itself is courtesy of the Hanuhanu.

50.original: I'll give you enough vials of repellent to get the job done. Drop by the enclosure and sprinkle a few drops on each alpaca's back. That's all there is to it!

52.original: The alpaca murmurs contentedly. With its lustrous coat gleaming, the creature looks ready to charge around in delight.

53.original: Easy girl, easy! They're just trying to keep you healthy!

55.original: You hear the creature breathing softly. It seems completely at ease.

57.original: You must have surprised the alpaca while it was drinking. Fortunately, it appears unoffended by the intrusion.

58.original: Thank you for handling that. How are the alpacas faring?

59.original: I see, I see... It always surprises me how creatures in the same herd can behave so differently. We'll have to make sure we cater to their individual temperaments!

60.original: The Hanu use the same repellent on their younglings. It's about as pungent as you'd expect for something that wards off the region's pests, but it's perfectly harmless.

61.original: The Turali Travel Agency relies as much on the alpacas as any other member of staff. They're just as deserving of the finest care!
